distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Ambrosiophilus subnepotulus from Guizhou, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports the accepted Taiwan occurrence; the current geographic synthesis is unchanged.

host_note: Albizia lebbeck is retained as the reported species-level host and is independently reported by Beaver & Liu (2010).
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ambrosiophilus subnepotulus (Eggers, 1930).

taxonomic_history.name: Xyleborus cristatuloides
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 284.

taxonomic_history.name: Ambrosiophilus subnepotulus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the placement in Ambrosiophilus as a new combination; this nomenclatural provenance is preserved.
